LanguageData.RM_SuulkFeedingStarted: A suulk has settled against {0}, feeding — its glow is dimming.
LanguageData.RM_SuulkFedOutText: The suulk has fed {0} down to nothing. The light is gone.
LanguageData.RM_SuulkArrivalText: Something soft and dark drifts in from beyond the beams, working its way toward the brightest light your colony carries. It means no harm to anyone standing — only to what they are standing under.
LanguageData.RM_VauliskRevealed: The lamp was never a lamp. A vaulisk strikes — no piip, no breathing pulse, and now no disguise.
